title: Ahoɔyaw a Ɛsɛee no
intro: Anansesɛm a akyɛ sen ahenni anaa kyerɛwsɛm biara—adesamma awerɛhosɛm a edi kan a ahoɔyaw woo no. Ɔkra biako, a na ɔyɛ mma baanu a awofo a wodi kan no woo wɔn mu panyin, de abufuw hwɛɛ sɛnea onua kumaa bi nyaa adom a wɔpowee no. Nea edii akyi bae no yɛ nea wɔpaw no mu nea ɛyɛ sum sen biara, na ɛmaa mogya a edi kan a wohwie gui wɔ asase so pɛn no. So wubetumi ada onipa ko a ɔyɛ, sɔhwɛ no, ne ahonu a ɛyɛ yaw no adi?
clues: Nnipa baanu a wodii kan nantew asase so na wɔwoo me.
Bere bi meyɛɛ afɔrebɔde maa Allah, nanso wɔannye antom amfi me hɔ.
Wogyee me nua afɔrebɔde no toom, bere a wɔpoo me de no—biribi a na mintumi nnyina ano.
Mede ɔsɛe hunahunaa m’ankasa me nuabarima.
Mebɛyɛɛ obi a odi kan a odii awu wɔ asase yi so, gyee m’ankasa me nua nkwa.
Allah somaa asaase so abɔdeɛ bi — anomaa tuntum bi a ɔretutu fam — sɛ ɔmmɛkyerɛ me sɛdeɛ mede dee mayɛ besie, na wɔannya biribiara gye sɛ mennuu me ho.

verse: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers. (5:30)
